verdict.rationale: Zero's own GitHub README calls it "an open-source AI email solution" and "An Open-Source Gmail Alternative." The public repo exposes readable source, including raw staging files (MCP.md, AGENT.md, CONTRIBUTING.md) and devcontainer setup instructions. Missing for 10: the specific license (name or terms) is not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent corroboration of the license status.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Zero is an open-source AI email solution that gives users the power to **self-host** their own email app
An Open-Source Gmail Alternative for the Future of Email
